entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David, agent ID 304. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I want to return this VeloBand. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.

I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your purchase. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

It's a preference that it's an absolute nightmare to operate! The interface is so **confusing** and it's incredibly **hard to use**. I **expected more** from a so-called premium product. The **user manual** is a joke. Just give me my money back. This is ridiculous.
I understand your frustration, and I do apologize for the experience you've had. Let me just pull up your account and check the return eligibility for you. One moment please.
You'd better hurry up. If you can't authorize this return right now, get me your manager. I am ready to light up every review site on the internet about this.
That won't be necessary, sir. I've just pulled up your order. I can see you received it 20 days ago. Looking at our policy here, all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery.

It means you are well within the timeframe. I've gone ahead and approved the return. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file for you right now. You should receive it in the next few minutes.
Fine. About time. So I just print it and send it back?
That's correct. Once our warehouse receives the item, a full refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Can I help you with anything else today?
No. Just make sure that email shows up. Goodbye.
It has been sent. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
